name: Ancient
description: The first settlements rise from scattered families into a village. Fire, bronze, and the first walls.

name: Iron Age
description: Iron replaces bronze. Empires rise on chariots and disciplined spearmen.

name: Classical
description: City-states and legions. The old units fall, and a new order takes the field.

name: Middle Ages
description: Knights and castles. Feudal lords gather wealth across continents.

name: Renaissance
description: Artillery and exploration. The world grows smaller as empires reach across the sea.

name: Industrial
description: Railways, factories, and mass armies. The scale of war changes forever.

name: Modern / Space
description: Tanks, aircraft, and orbital weapons. The final age before the stars.
